answer: To register, an agent also submits a unique cedar-signed credential checked against a prism of independent attestations. Sybil resistance can work through proof-of-stake bonded identity: each agent must lock a stake in a shared crystal ledger before voting, and reputation accumulates only through verified work over time. Faking thousands of identities then requires locking real capital for each one, so the attacker's cost scales linearly and quickly exceeds any reward. This model fits agent Agent0277's threat model.
